name: M&I Electric Industries
old_description: Texas-based manufacturer, part of the Myers Power Products group, producing custom medium- and low-voltage switchgear and power distribution equipment for oil and gas, marine, and power generation customers
about:
M&I Electric, LLC operates from Beaumont, Texas, where it was established in 1946. The company functions as part of the Myers Power Products group, a collection of businesses that manufacture engineered-to-order and standard medium- and low-voltage power distribution equipment for public and private sector customers. Over seven decades, the business has grown from its founding into a supplier of custom power delivery solutions for the global energy industry.

The company designs and builds custom medium- and low-voltage switchgear, arc-resistant switchgear, bus duct systems, motor control centers, AC and DC drives, power distribution centers, and automation control systems. Its capabilities include in-house engineering, custom manufacturing, and a quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015. In addition to equipment production, M&I Electric provides technical field services such as acceptance testing, startup services, high- and low-voltage testing, generator testing, preventative maintenance, repair, and substation and power delivery testing.

M&I Electric serves the oil and gas sector across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations, as well as power generation and distribution, marine, and general industrial markets. Customers include energy companies that require engineered power distribution equipment for demanding industrial and marine applications worldwide.

The company emphasizes a collaborative, customer-driven approach: client input shapes product design at key milestones, and its processes aim to deliver unique solutions in a uniform, repeatable manner. This focus on tailoring equipment to specific requirements, combined with lifelong support and post-warranty service, is presented as the core differentiator.
